project_type: Python Flask single-page web application with client-side view switching
test_framework: No formal test framework - manual verification via running the server
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt. 2. Run: python app.py. 3. Access http://localhost:5000/ai to verify MAKIMA AI page. 4. Test POST /api/ai-chat endpoint with curl.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to install packages. GEMINI_API_KEY env var available on Railway.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify existing features. Do NOT touch TikTok Downloader. Do NOT put API keys in code. Use GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

key_patterns.routing: Flask routes defined in app.py, single index.html template served at /
key_patterns.view_switching: Client-side view navigation via data-view attributes on drawer items, managed in static/js/ui.js with navigateTo() function and viewConfig object
key_patterns.sidebar: Side drawer defined in templates/index.html with drawer-item class, data-view and data-feature attributes, badges (active-badge, soon-badge)
key_patterns.css_theme: Dark red/black theme using CSS variables in static/css/variables.css. Glass backgrounds, red glows, font families: Anton/Bebas Neue for logos, Rajdhani/Oswald for UI, Poppins for body
key_patterns.state_management: Global JS state variables in static/js/config.js, currentView tracks active view

directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask server), analytics.py (analytics module), templates/index.html (single page), static/css/ (7 CSS files), static/js/ (8 JS files), static/img/, static/icons/
